title: Common
description: Shared building blocks for every Sajao v1 object. Lengths are metres, angles are degrees, money is INR in minor units.

SchemaVersion.description: Contract version of the object. Minor versions only add optional fields.

LocalId.description: Identifier that is unique inside its parent object, for example a wall or a design item.

StorageKey.description: Object key in the media store. Never a public URL; clients receive signed URLs.

SpaceType.description: What the scanned space is. Detected from the scan, never picked up front; the user can change it.

DetectionSource.description: detected: worked out from the scan. user: changed or confirmed by the user.

ProductGroup.description: Top-level grouping used for the cost breakdown.

DimensionSource.description: measured: tape or verified retailer data. estimated: from geometry models or unverified listings. user_confirmed: accepted by the user without a tape value.

Dimension.description: A length that is honest about where it came from. Every dimension carries a value, a source and an error band.

error_band_m.description: Half-width of the error band in metres: the true value is expected within value_m plus or minus error_band_m. The solver adds it as margin.

Point2.description: A point on the floor in the space frame, in metres.

Polygon.description: Closed floor polygon; the last point joins the first.

Money.description: A price. Set only from retailer data, never by a generative model.

ProductRoute.description: A permitted affiliate or rental route to a product.

url.description: Retailer destination. The app always opens it through the redirect service.

price.description: Purchase price for buy routes; price per month for rent routes.
